promo.copyBlocked: Your browser blocked copying. Long-press the address to copy it manually.
promo.copiedTalk: Address copied — paste it into a KakaoTalk chat.
promo.noShare: This device cannot open a share dialog. Copy the address and paste it into KakaoTalk.
promo.offTitle: Create a link first — “Create my referral link”
promo.noLink: You have no links yet. Create one with “Create my referral link”.

region.sggOnly: Enter the city, county or district only (no neighborhood or unit number).
region.needOne: Turn on at least one area. With no areas on, you will not receive leads.
region.savedN: Saved — you will receive leads in {n, plural, one {{n} area} other {{n} areas}}.
region.saveFail: Could not save. Please try again shortly.
region.onTitle: Active in {n, plural, one {{n} area} other {{n} areas}}
region.noneOff: No areas are off. Tap an area above to move it here.
region.dirty: Your changes have not been saved yet.

home.title: Safe Referral Partner Center
home.sub: Register listings and services, receive inquiries, and get settled here. This is separate from the Affiliate Partner Center.
home.applyFirst: Please apply as a partner first.
home.idDone: Identity verification complete — you will apply as an individual.
home.afterVerify: Once you apply and pass SogaeBank's review, you can register services and receive leads.
home.idFirst: Identity verification comes first. Once verified, you can apply as an individual (business verification is optional).
home.tSettleSub: Paid on day {day} of next month
home.blockedNote: You are not receiving leads — {n, plural, one {{n} issue} other {{n} issues}} are blocking them. Resolve them below and leads resume right away.
home.noBlock: Nothing is blocking. You can receive leads.
home.feeNote: The lead fee is an information fee. It is deducted from your prepaid balance the moment you open contact details, whether or not the deal closes. It is different from the referral fee, which the parties pay each other directly.

apply.title: Apply to join
apply.sub: Identity/business check → Application → SogaeBank approval. You can list services after SogaeBank approval. The view fee is deducted from your balance only when you open a lead.
apply.s1P: Once your identity is verified, you apply right away as an individual. To apply as a business, complete business verification (National Tax Service check) — optional.
apply.s2P: Choose the industries and areas you want. You can change them later.
apply.rejFix: You can apply again after fixing the issue.
apply.s3P: A person reviews it. There is no automatic approval — even when records match, identity theft cannot be ruled out automatically.
apply.s3Wait: Received. We will notify you of the result within 1–2 business days.
apply.axisFirst: Identity verification comes first. Once verified, you can choose the tracks to join here (business verification is optional).
apply.notify: Our team reviews every application directly. If rejected, we send the reason as an alert and you can fix it and reapply. Once approved, the status here and on the Partner Center home changes to “Approved”.

notesSrv.brand: Brand materials are a trust display unit, not a service listing unit.
notesSrv.staff: Invite staff who are already members by email; they join once they accept (invitation emails are not sent yet — please tell them directly).
notesSrv.info: If the National Tax Service authenticity and closure checks are not connected yet, the status shows as “Assumed” — do not rely on it. Changes are submitted as requests and approved by SogaeBank.

biz.title: Company · Account
biz.sub: See business info, accounts, terms, and brand in one place.
biz.noBizNo: None — active as an individual (identity verified · v10.38 P2P)
biz.bizOnly: Only if you receive payments as a business —
biz.unpaidCapNote: · Applies only to unbilled amounts from before the switch (lead fees are prepaid)
biz.ntsWarn: Do not use NTS lookup results as the basis for decisions.
biz.notApplied: You have not applied to join yet.
biz.legalReview: · Under legal review (not yet in effect)
biz.termsNote: You can view each version of the terms you agreed to on the Terms page. We ask for consent again when they change.
biz.ownerOnly: Company settings are managed by the owner account.

bizForm.changeNote: The business registration number cannot be changed (a different business needs a new application). SogaeBank approves requests, and approved changes apply immediately.
bizForm.removeAsk: Remove this staff account? They will no longer be able to access the Partner Center.
bizForm.logoHas: (registered — upload a new one to replace)
bizForm.name: Name
bizForm.siteNote: We only take city/county/district (no detailed address).
bizForm.inviteNote: If you accept, you will share that business’s Partner Center.

trust.title: Trust indicators
trust.sub: Badges are awarded automatically when conditions are met and removed when they no longer are.
trust.badgeNote: Partners do not turn badges on or off — they are awarded automatically based on conditions. When a condition no longer holds, its badge is removed automatically.
trust.labelNote:
Industry-specific labels

“Total ○○” badge names follow the label of the industry with the most approved services (if most industries have no label, “Total closed”) — so a solar-only label like “Total installs” never shows up on other industries.
trust.respP: Low numbers mean fewer leads. If you receive leads and do not respond, requesters are left waiting.
trust.recvSub: Inquiries assigned to you so far
trust.viewRateSub: Share of received leads whose contact details you opened — below 60%, you are ranked lower in lead assignment
trust.avgViewSub: Time from receiving to opening — after 3 hours, requesters talk to someone else first
trust.slowNote: If you are slow to view leads, requesters talk to another business first.
trust.lowNote: A low view rate ranks you lower in lead assignment.
trust.stable: Your indicators are stable. Keeping them this way works in your favor for assignment.
trust.unviewed: Leads you do not view are not charged. But if it keeps happening, you will be assigned fewer — it is better to open only as many areas and industries as you can handle.

tracks.title: Dedicated tracks
tracks.notPartner: You are not a partner. Please start with <apply>Apply to join</apply>.
tracks.sub: Each category takes requests differently — quote inbox · listings · catalog.
tracks.emptyRepair: No quote requests yet. Open your <regions>service areas</regions> and <services>repair · body services</services> to get assigned.
tracks.emptyCar: No used car listings. Post one under “Car” in <reg>Register a listing</reg> and it will appear here.
tracks.emptyCatalog: No products registered. Register rental or sale items below.
tracks.noTrack: Your approved services currently include no dedicated-track industries (repair · used cars · rental).

perf.noteSrv: For contract-based services, a deal counts only after the partner reports fulfilment and the consumer confirms it. Deals are unrelated to view fees.
perf.title: Performance
perf.sub: For contract-closing services, the partner reports fulfillment and the deal closes once the consumer confirms.
perf.empty: No fulfillment reports yet. When you finish a job, report it below.
perf.consumerNote: The member who made the inquiry confirms it in My page. They receive a confirmation alert — guest and older requests have no confirmation screen and stay “Awaiting customer confirmation”.

reportForm.none: Nothing to report — you can only report fulfillment for inquiries whose contact details you opened (paid the view fee).
reportForm.contentPh: e.g. Moving · 3-room · Songpa (do not include contact details)

stats.title: Results
stats.sub: Your spending depends on the grades of the leads you receive.
stats.note: Your grade distribution determines your spending. As S · A bands grow, view-fee spending rises even if the count stays the same. “Ungraded” leads had no notification result and were charged the base rate.

notices.title: Notices · Alerts
notices.subUnread: SogaeBank notices and your alerts. You have {n} unread alerts.
notices.note: Even if you miss a notification message, it stays here. You can review policy changes and billing notices in this list anytime.

reviews.title: Approval · Rejection history
reviews.sub: Review results and how to resubmit. For rejected items, fix the issue noted in the reason and resubmit.
reviews.empty: No review history yet. It builds up here once you register services.
reviews.note: If rejected, fix and resubmit that item instead of registering a new one. A new submission adds a duplicate to the review queue and delays the result.

regions.title: Service areas
regions.sub: Leads come only from areas you turn on, by city/county/district.
regions.none: No areas are on, so no leads are coming in. Turn on at least one area.
regions.count: Receiving leads in {n, plural, one {{n} area} other {{n} areas}}.
regions.addrNote: We do not use detailed addresses. Matching only goes down to city/county/district — neighborhood and unit numbers can identify a specific person, so we never store them.
regions.freeNote: Turning on areas with few leads costs nothing. No fee is charged unless you view a lead — receiving is free.
